session_archive._note: When true, the full transcript at SessionEnd is copied alongside the chunks so retrieval can link to the source. When false, only chunk bodies are retained.

embedder._note: Backend selector. `ollama` (default) talks to a local Ollama daemon. `none` skips embedding entirely; retrieval no-ops without vectors. `fastembed` and `remote` are reserved for a future landing.
embedder._max_input_chars_note: Longest body worth sending to the embedder. nomic-embed-text holds roughly 2048 tokens and answers HTTP 500 above about 7k characters. The chunker splits turns to fit, so this is a backstop for a raised chunk_target_chars or a model with a smaller window; without it an oversize body comes back as a bare HTTP 500 that reads like a server fault.

ollama._keep_alive_note: How long ollama holds the model in memory after a request. Its own default is 5 minutes, so any session starting more than five minutes after the last embed paid a cold load — measured at 11.24s against this 8s timeout, which therefore always failed. Holding it longer costs nothing when the model is already resident.

surfacer._note: Retrieval always surfaces top-1 (per the design's deliberate top-1 inject). Multi-result surfacing is reserved for a future `/historian recall` skill rather than the UserPromptSubmit inject path.
